name: Caustic Vapor
description: The door slams shut, and poison gas fills the room.
disable: DC 36 Occultism (master) or DC 36 Religion (master) to exorcise the spirits

generalAbilities.name: Breath Snatcher
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature other than an ooze spends at least 3 rounds in the room

Effect The trap activates and fills the area with caustic nightmare vapor, exposing all creatures within.

generalAbilities.name: Caustic Nightmare Vapor
generalAbilities.description:
Oozes are immune to this poison

Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 round

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 Acid Damage damage and Confused (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 Acid Damage damage, confused, and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 Acid Damage damage, confused, off-guard, and Stupefied 2 (1 round)
